column1: # Speech level of an utterance from its cue key (R, decision order step 1 and 4 of DESIGN.md §4.4).
# The share column is the share of dev game dialogue lines with this key whose human translation has the
# level (5 works, scenes outside the held-out set; 76,553 lines), so a row can be re-derived and audited.
#   key     the first cue key that holds, in this order: narr (a quote inside a narration line), empty (no
#           word), set, keigo-pend, pend, keigo, archaic, polite-any, stiff, casual, bare
#   profile yes: when the speaker's scoped profile is polite (share of polite lines > threshold), use haeyo
